description: Scene check (B-1266, B-1267): the Carrington Institute's stage, loaded through --launch-mission 0x26, which is the front end (Agent Select opens over it). The scene must hold every triangle the ROM draws for the stage (11,519 in 140 rooms; the export used to leave out 5 rooms with 1,903 of them) and draw 11,413 of them with back faces culled. Two screenshots of the front end over the Institute.

input_sequence.comment: The boot only: stage 0x26 loads as the front end's background and Agent Select opens over it, so there is no gameplay to wait for.
The Institute behind Agent Select, about 20 s after the stage has loaded.

required_lines: SCENARIO\.RENDER: activated source scene 'base:scenario_citraining' source=\S+ vertices=34557
SCENARIO\.RENDER: culling 'base:scenario_citraining' single_sided_groups=[1-9][0-9]* of [0-9]+ triangles=11413 of 11519 front=(counter_clockwise|clockwise)
